policy: Proposed statuses must be reconciled with completed independent evidence before site publication; historical round12 records remain immutable.

items.title: Connected-graph local dynamics
items.status: selected, implementation and independent review pending
items.acceptance: A graph-independent bound for bounded observables with explicit boundary-distance decay.
items.rejection: Refuse total-volume constants, wrong incidence or implied norm-time continuity.

items.title: Exact rational compact moment bounds
items.status: selected, implementation and independent review pending
items.acceptance: Exact endpoint exclusion, support matrices and an independent reference at held-out parameters.
items.rejection: Reject false closures, omitted support, sign/zero parameter mistakes.

items.title: All-order compact hierarchy uniqueness and interval convergence
items.acceptance: Critic review of distribution equation, endpoint atoms, moment existence and diagonal compactness.
items.rejection: No finite-order equality or convergence rate asserted.

items.title: Bidirectional dependency replay
items.acceptance: Actual forward/backward meeting for local and moment branches with negative controls.
items.rejection: Final target remains unreachable when physical-scale and reconstruction premises are absent.

items.title: Qualitative fixed-spacing Hamiltonian gap stability
items.acceptance: Exact infinite-dimensional primary theorem match, boundary padding, Gauss restriction and qualitative smallness.
items.rejection: No numerical smallness threshold or continuum transfer asserted.

items.title: Quantitative stability threshold
items.acceptance: Extract and independently replay explicit constants for the actual finite interaction range.
items.rejection: Existential constants cannot classify a numerical coupling as certified.

items.title: Ground states beyond the small static perturbation regime
items.acceptance: Construct compatible states and identify a positive limiting generator.
items.rejection: A locality bound alone is not a gap.

items.title: Moment constraints on interacting loop observables
items.acceptance: Derive exact shared-link identities and positivity matrices for connected graphs.
items.rejection: One-plaquette Gibbs moments are not coupled Hamiltonian ground-state moments.

items.title: Controlled removal of a deformation
items.acceptance: Same observable family, explicit action and uniform errors along compactification/deformation path.
items.rejection: Do not assume absence of a phase transition or interchange large-N and circle limits.

items.title: Four-dimensional construction and physical gap
items.acceptance: Matched scale limits, nontriviality, reconstruction and positive physical rate on a dense sector.
items.rejection: No present finite-model result supplies these hypotheses.
